<!-- Shared body of each comparison page. Each page sets `branch` and `type`
     and includes this file. -->

```{r}
#| include: false
library(biocUniTools)
config <- yaml::read_yaml("../config.yml")
data_file <- file.path("..", config$data_dir,
                       sprintf("compare-%s-%s.rds", branch, type))
has_data <- file.exists(data_file)
if (has_data) {
    cmp <- readRDS(data_file)
    s <- compare_summary(cmp)
}
tile <- function(value, label)
    sprintf('<div class="stat-tile"><div class="value">%s</div><div class="label">%s</div></div>',
            value, label)
compared <- if (type == "workflows")
    "BBS `R CMD build` and R Universe source `R CMD check`" else
    "`R CMD check` on both"
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!has_data) {
    cat("No data yet. Run `biocUniTools::write_comparisons(\"reports/config.yml\")`.\n")
} else {
    cat(sprintf("Bioconductor %s (%s), %s. BBS node `%s` and R Universe `%s`. Updated %s.\n\n",
                cmp$bioc_version[1], branch, config$platform,
                stats::na.omit(cmp$bbs_node)[1],
                stats::na.omit(cmp$uni_universe)[1],
                format(attr(cmp, "created"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")))
    cat(sprintf("Results compared: %s. NOTE counts as OK; WARNINGS matches WARNING.\n\n",
                compared))
    cat('<div class="stat-tiles">',
        tile(s$packages, "packages"),
        tile(s$bbs_only + s$universe_only, "built by only one system"),
        tile(s$commits_differ, "commits differ"),
        tile(s$results_differ, "results differ"),
        tile(s$check_diverged, "R Universe check ≠ binary check"),
        '</div>\n', sep = "\n")
}
```

if (has_data) compare_table(cmp)
